title: Ruuhu Hokkuɗo Leydi Ceniindi
intro: Hade maa ina woodi daartol cuusal keewngal, ɗo neɗɗo gooto cuusi luulndaade geɗe ɓurɗe tiiɗde e siwil en fof. Rewtu e ɗii ɗoo ƴattooje gila e ko yawti, aɗa heɓa nguurndam maantinɗam e goonɗinal ngal aldaa e paltoor, nguurndam kaawisaaji, e lelnugol tuugnorgal baawngal waylude yahdu ruuhuyankeewu miliyaaruuji. Rewru kala teskuyaaji no moƴƴi — yiite ceniingo ina siftora haa jooni.
clues: Mi jibinaa ko e galle teddinoowo tagopeeje kammu e sanamuuji cewɗi, kono won ko luggiɗi e nder am ina salii ko ɓe ndewata koo.
Mi dariima e laamɗo leydi am ɓurɗo semmbe, mi ɓuuɓtii sanamuuji ɗi leñol am sujji, mi anndini wonde ko Tagɗo asamaan oo tan foti reweede.
Pire ɓuuɓnde yamiraama e innde am, kono mi anndinii wonde Mo liggortoomi oo tan hisnata mi — kadi ɓuuɓol ngol yamiraama yo won cooyngol e kisal.
Miɗo acci kala ko nganndu-mi e yamiroore Alla, miɗo ƴaañii e nder falndeeji joorɗi e ɓesngu am, miɗo hoolii e ballal ngal mi yi’aani tawo.
E daraade sara ɓiɗɗo am gadano e nder falnde ɓuuɓnde, min ndarni e dow ŋoral galle ceniɗo, nokku ceniɗo mo kala ɗooftotooɗo.
Miɗo anndiraa Khalilullah — sehil am ɓurɗo yurmeende — innde am wonti haa abada jokkondirnde e iimanaagal jokkere enɗam e ɗooftaare.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
